---
title: "IOTC Statistical Data Reporting: Form 3AA"
---
  
## Description
  
This form provides for the annual reporting of fishing activities conducted around anchored fish aggregated devices (AFADs) located in the IOTC area of competence along with estimates of retained catches and discards for the IOTC species, common sharks, and other bycatch species caught in association with IOTC fisheries.

Click [here](./Form-3AA.xlsx) to download a blank version of Form 3AA, or [return](./index.html) to the list of all IOTC statistical data reporting forms. The form allows reporting updated data for multiple fisheries simultaneously.

## Data Content

Daily information on AFOB-related activities along with estimates of total number and/or live weight of retained catches and discards by species, fate, raising status, and catch unit.

### General Information

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| Reporting year | M | Gregorian calendar year of the fishing activities reported through the dataset | 4-digit integer | `1996` |
| Reporting entity | M | Three-letter (alpha-3) code of the entity reporting the dataset to the IOTC Secretariat | **Code** from [Entities](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#entities) | `MDV` | 
| Flag state | M | Country in which a fishing vessel is registered and whose flag it is entitled to fly | **Code** from [Countries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#countries) | `MDV` |

### Main Data Elements

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| Month | M | Gregorian calendar month of the fishing activities reported through the dataset | Integer (1-12) | `11` |
| Day of the month | M | Day of the month of the fishing activities reported through the dataset | Integer (1-31) | `25` |  
| Fisheries | M | [IOTC fishery](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/guidelines/stats/index.html#Fisheries) used to define fishing practices, which emerge from the combination of fishery purposes, area of operation, fishing vessels' size, gear and gear configuration, and target species | **Code** from [Fisheries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/fisheries/index.html#fisheries) | `PL-AF[IN]TR` |
| Latitude | M | The latitude of the fishing activity, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | Float based on [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DD.DDDD] | `2.5402` | 
| Longitude | M | The longitude of the drifting floating object location, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | Float based on [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DDD.DDDD] | `73.0214` |
| Species | M | Species caught | **Code** from [Species](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#allSpecies) | `YFT` | 
| Type of fate | M | Fate of fish caught (retained or discarded) | **Code** from [Types of fate](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#typesOfFate) | `RE` | 
| Data raising | M | Level of raising (i.e., extrapolation) | **Code** from [Raisings](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/data/index.html#raisings) | `NR` |
| Catch unit | M | Units used to report the level of catches of a given species | **Code** from [Catch units](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/fisheries/index.html#catchUnits) | `KG` |

### AFOB Data

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| Identifier | M | Unique identifier of the floating object | String | `Q09D01-01` |
| Type | M | Type of anchored floating object | **Code** from [AFOB types](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/fisheries/index.html#AFOBtypes) | `AFAD` | 
| Activity | M | Type of activities undertaken when deploying or visiting an anchored floating object | **Code** from [AFOB activity types](#AFOBactivityTypes) | `VF` |

## Reporting Metadata

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
| :-------- | :----: | :----------------------- | :-------- | :------------ |
| Liaison officer full name | M | Name of the liaison officer in charge of the compilation of the data | String | `John Doe` |
| Liaison officer email	| M | Email address of the liaison officer in charge of the compilation of the data | Valid email address | `John.Doe@fao.org` |
| Organisation name | M | Name of the organisation in charge of the compilation of the data | String | `Institute of Fisheries` |
| Organisation email | O | Email address of the organisation in charge of the compilation of the data | Valid email address | `nif@gov.sc` |
| Finalisation date | M | Date of finalisation of the dataset | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) | `1996-03-27` |
| Submission date | O | Date of submission of the dataset | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) | `1997-03-21` |

## Reporting Deadlines

- **Coastal and surface fisheries**: 30 June (final)
